mechanism: Armodafinil is a CNS stimulant that increases wakefulness and dopaminergic activity, while nalmefene is an opioid antagonist; combined use may increase CNS stimulation and potentially mask opioid-related respiratory depression if opioids are co-administered.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS stimulation; use with caution in patients with cardiovascular disease or seizure history; ensure no concurrent opioid use without careful monitoring.
